requiredBehavior: Use a retained in-process typed MNCS session or stable embedding boundary for store semantic calls, while retaining host code only for filesystem/process transport and explicit platform effects.
summary: Profile 0.18 and mncs-embed provide retained in-process typed sessions, but mncs-store still routes each semantic batch through a fresh CLI experiment and JSON corpus. The remaining gap is consumer integration, not absence of all in-process execution support.
title: mncs-store persistence driver still lacks retained in-process MNCS session
